lessons: A static guard test over the whole package (rglob) beats a hardcoded module list: it caught a live ESTIMATE| aggregation in cli.py that the module list missed.

For kill -9 / lease-expiry tests, wall-clock sleeps are the flake vector; quarantining with an explicit opt-in flag plus a tracked un-quarantine spec is the honest gate discipline when the exact failing assert can't be reproduced on demand.

The honest-label fix touched three layers (writer, docstring convention, CLI presentation) — the presentation layer (costs CLI) still spoke the old estimate/actual language and would have kept the confusion alive.

summary: Two owner-ordered tasks. T-043 (cost labels, owner decision 2026-09-29): the misleading ACTUAL| label on $0.00 unmetered cost-ledger rows is fixed — queue.COST_UNMETERED_LABEL = 'unmetered - subscription', and the two requeue/review ledger writes in retry.py now emit 'UNMETERED|<detail> (unmetered - subscription)'. log_cost() docstring convention rewritten: ACTUAL| = real cost on a paid API call computed ONLY from API-returned usage numbers; UNMETERED| = subscription-covered, usd 0.0, fixed label; ESTIMATE| = RESERVED/unused (no estimated cost model, no invented per-unit prices). New queue.log_metered_cost() is the single sanctioned path for real costs (no paid API callers exist yet: local faster-whisper ASR, one-time free model fetch). The `costs` CLI totals line now prints 'actual: $X (N unmetered rows)' instead of the estimate/actual split. T-044 (flaky crash-recovery test): tests/test_cli.py::test_worker_crash_recovery_sha256 is quarantined via @pytest.mark.quarantine + tests/conftest.py (--run-quarantined to run explicitly; skipped in the default gate). The test does kill -9 mid-render plus a blind 12s sleep for an 8s lease expiry; it flaked 1/3 full-suite controller runs (AssertionError) while passing alone and under CPU load. Prime race candidates: (1) the 60s wall-clock budget for worker A to reach 'rendering' under load, or the test process being descheduled so the worker finishes before the kill is observed; (2) orphaned ffmpeg child timing vs the blind sleep. Un-quarantining requires replacing the blind sleep with a poll-until-lease-expired loop AND a deterministic kill point (worker-side sync marker or lease-expiry injection hook), then 5 consecutive green full-suite runs. Nothing pushed.
